Entries.Original: Wow... What an elegant atmosphere. I-I feel a bit out of place here.
Welcome to BAR Sobriety, a private hideaway for weary soldiers exhausted from a long day of training or fieldwork.
Wha?
How may I help you, young lady?
Who are you?!
The name's Minori Ohshima. Please, have a seat at the counter, anywhere you like.
Y-You seem really different from usual. Gave me quite the shock.
That would be because I am the bartender of this fine establishment tonight. My story goes back, three days in the past...
Outta the way! Delivery comin' through!
Hey, Barkeep! I've got a delivery!
Hey there, Minori. I see you're working hard, as usual.
Huh? Instructor Asami? Where's the barkeep?
Seems like she strained her back on the job. Asked me to come sign for the delivery in her place.
Oh no! Is she okay?!
She'll be fine so long as she takes it easy for a bit, so the bar's closing for a while. Shame. This place is like an oasis for us weary troops who need a little R&R.
She's always saying how she wants to give everyone a relaxing time, even if it's only for an hour or two.
She can't fight on the front lines, so she does everything she can to help the soldiers unwind. I really mean it when I say it's a shame.
I offered to run the place for her while she takes time off, but according to her, I'd be too drunk to serve anyone anything.
And there's nobody else who could take over, so I guess we're S.O.L.
Um, Instructor Asami, I dunno if this'll work, but...could I run the bar in her place?
You?
It's a wonderful place, and every day it's closed is a shame.
I've got no experience at all, but I've watched her mix drinks before when I was making deliveries here. With some practice, I'm pretty sure I can do it.
Besides, I've always wanted to give it a try. I kind of admire what she does.
Hell, you sound serious... Alright. Not gonna lie, every day where I can't drown my sorrows at the bar'll be torture.
I'll let her and Tezuka know. She seems to have taken a liking to you, so I'm pretty sure she'll agree to it.
Thanks, Instructor!
Now, that said, I'm only giving you permission so long as you promise it won't get in the way of your missions.
It won't! I'll do my very best!
So that's what happened. Still, your current demeanor is quite a departure from how you normally carry yourself.
I referenced Ichiko's manga to sculpt this cool bartender demeanor.
Now, young lady, what would you like to order?
Oh, uh... Sorry, I've never even been somewhere like this before. What should I order?
Follow my lead, lass. Barkeep. The usual.
Instructor Asami? You seem somewhat different from usual too.
Hah. A bar is an intoxicating portal. Drift through, and you find yourself in a fantasy land where you can be whatever you want to be. This is a world that belongs only to adults.
I-I see...but this is my first time here, so I don't have a usual drink.
Any true bartender is able to discern the "usual" that customers desire simply by observing them.
I thought that was called dealer's choice.
Allow me...
Shaking time.
*shake shake*
Here's your Dead Green Frog.
Dead Green What?!
Behold, the green of a dead frog, finished with a pour of red blood... A visually striking drink.
Ahh... This is perfect, Barkeep.
And that's one special night, delivered.
What the heck just happened?!
Phew... Barkeep, bring me a snack to pair with the drink. It's a tad too sweet for a brute like me.
I thought you just said it was perfect.
Coming right up. Now it's...
Shaking time.
Why are you shaking her snack?!
Here's your mixed nuts.
Okay, that is not right!
Is something amiss, young lady?
You put a bunch of liquids in that shaker, so how did you end up with nuts?! What is this, alchemy?!
Any bartender worth her salt can do this.
Are bartenders able to do literally anything?! What was the shaking even for?!
Ahh... This is perfect, Barkeep.
And that's one special night, delivered.
Is there some rule that says you have to say that?
Eek!
Barkeeeeeep, anotherrr!
That girl down there... That's that one girl from 31-X, right? Wait, is she drunk?
When serving minors, this establishment only offers non-alcoholic beverages. Nonetheless, we do occasionally have patrons who find themselves drunk on the atmosphere alone.
At any rate, another of the same drink, correct? Coming right up.
Shaking time.
Here's your corn potage.
That's not something you get at a bar!
Shaking the soup distributes the corn kernels evenly, making for a more enjoyable drinking experience.
Yes, the corn does tend to sink to the bottom, but come on!
Oh, yes, this is superb, Barkeep!
And that's one special night, delivered.
